rule T8_iam_pam {
  meta:
    author = "SOC Analyst"
  description = "Disable compromised service account svc_etl_prod and revoke OAuth tokens"
  reference = "SEC-PROC-441"
  tags = "iam, pam, containment"

  strings:
    $ svc_etl_prod$ = /svc_etl_prod

  condition:
    any of them
      $ svc_etl_prod$ = /svc_etl_prod

  action:
    disable_account(svc_etl_prod)
    revoke_tokens(scope=oauth)
}
